description:
Modify the HVAC fan operation schedules for the 4StoreyBuilding to reflect extended business hours. 

1. Locate the weekday fan operation Day Schedule (often named 'Fan Weekday' or similar). Update it to operate from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM (Hours 7-22). The values should be 1 (On) for hours 7 through 22, and 0 (Off) for all other hours.

2. Locate the Saturday fan operation Day Schedule. Update it to operate from 7:00 AM to 1:00 PM (Hours 8-14). The values should be 1 (On) for hours 8 through 14, and 0 (Off) for all other hours.

3. Run the full annual DOE-2.2 energy simulation.
4. Save the project.

Note: In eQUEST schedules, Hour 1 corresponds to Midnight-1AM. Ensure your input values align with the 1-indexed hour convention.
